infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Fields accesses your camera to capture travel scenes for your carved stamp field notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Fields accesses your photo gallery to select travel photos and read capture dates and locations.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Fields saves your completed travel field note posters to your photo gallery.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Fields uses location metadata to identify travel destinations from your photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Field Notes accesses your selected photos to create travel field note stamps.
plugins.cameraPermission: Field Notes accesses your camera to capture scenes for your travel field note stamps.

plugins.photosPermission: Field Notes needs full access to your photo gallery to read photo capture locations and timestamps.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Field Notes saves your generated travel field note posters to your photo gallery.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Field Notes uses location data to identify travel destinations from your photos.
